facts.fact: AFIC's May 2024 presentation says Uganda's Access to Information Act (2005) elaborates how the constitutional right of access to information held by public bodies is exercised.
AFIC's May 2024 presentation says the Access to Information Act (2005) has Regulations (2011) that specify the information citizens can request and the exemptions.

note: The 2019 AFIC request figures are a civil-society count, not an oversight body or court, so no applied fact.
